artifacts.name: tuhin
artifacts.description: Tuhin's dev identity as a plugin: a task board where an untagged paragraph becomes a plan (requirement engineer: analysis, validation, feasibility, sizing, architecture deltas) and a tagged task becomes code — worktrees, Pint/Pest/PHPStan gates, draft PRs, bounded review-and-fix rounds, optional gated merge, hands-off /task-auto loop. Plus personal engineering skills (blast-radius, red-first, quality-audit, security-audit, performance-audit, vsa, readability-sweep, and more), a core SDLC pipeline (requirements → architecture → system design/model → api contract → task breakdown → UX design → deployment) and the tuhin digital-twin implementation agent. Pairs with Laravel Boost: Boost owns knowledge, this plugin owns process.

pluginReferences.name: skill-heaven
pluginReferences.description: Working prototype of Skill Heaven for Claude Code, actively tested for public use. One mechanic — /summon, one skill into context for one session, nothing installed — on one line: zero · low · med · high · xhigh · max · ultra, whose four surfaces are contiguous bands read from the current rung. /skill-zero is the floor, /skill-heaven converges, /skill-hell explores, and /skill-ultra is the crown rung whose controller picks direction and depth per gap. Nothing on the line refuses. No rung carries a count and no summon is capped — what each rung reaches for is being worked out in use while the benchmark is built. Interfaces may change. The zero-default launcher and standing-dose statusline live in the claude-zero package, run from a source checkout — not part of this marketplace install.
